metadata.description: Capture the selected mixed-zone quiet-hours week on light phone from its explicit disposable owner fixture; perform no saves.

evaluate.expression:
(()=>{const text=document.body.innerText;const expected=['Monday

13:00–14:00 · Etc/UTC','Wednesday
13:00–14:00 · Etc/UTC','Thursday
13:00–14:00 · Etc/UTC','Friday
13:00–14:00 · Etc/UTC'];if(expected.some(value=>!text.includes(value)))throw new Error(`selected mixed-zone values mismatch: ${text}`);const emptyDays=(text.match(/No quiet window/g)||[]).length;if(emptyDays!==2)throw new Error(`selected weekend values mismatch: ${emptyDays}`);document.querySelector('[data-testid="quiet-hours-root"]')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement&&document.activeElement.blur();const root=document.documentElement;root.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-top','0px');root.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-bottom','0px');const top=getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--safe-area-inset-top').trim(),bottom=getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--safe-area-inset-bottom').trim();if(innerWidth!==390||innerHeight!==844||devicePixelRatio!==2||top!=='0px'||bottom!=='0px')throw new Error(`selected viewport/insets mismatch: ${innerWidth}x${innerHeight}@${devicePixelRatio} ${top}/${bottom}`);return {expected,emptyDays,viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight,dpr:devicePixelRatio},top,bottom}})()
